exercises.instructions: Choose the correct determiner (some, any, a, an) for each sentence.

questions.question: There is ___ bread.
questions.explanation: 'some' is used with uncountable nouns in affirmative sentences. 'bread' is uncountable. 'some' ကို uncountable nouns နဲ့ affirmative sentences တွေမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: There aren't ___ bananas.
questions.explanation: 'any' is used with plural countable nouns in negative sentences. 'bananas' is plural countable. 'any' ကို negative sentences တွေမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: There is ___ university on this street.
questions.explanation: 'a' is used before words starting with a consonant sound. 'university' starts with a 'yoo' sound (consonant). 'a' ကို consonant sound ရှိတဲ့ စကားလုံးတွေရှေ့မှာ သုံးပါ။
